```sql
SELECT ROUND(
  SUM(CASE WHEN home_team_goal > away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*),
  4
) AS home_win_rate
FROM main."Match" m
JOIN main."League" l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE l.name = 'England Premier League'
  AND m.season = '2015/2016'
  AND m.date >= '2015-08-01'
  AND m.date <= '2016-05-25';
```
